BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Windows.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Windows.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Construction Plant, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Plant.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Plant.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Construction Plant.

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

5. When learning Scaffolding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scaffolding.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Scaffolding.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scaffolding.

6. When learning Site Organisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Site Organisation.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Organisation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Organisation.

7. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.

8. When learning Appropriate Technology in Building, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Appropriate Technology in Building.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Appropriate Technology in Building.

9. When learning Sanitary Appliances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Sanitary Appliances.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Sanitary Appliances.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Sanitary Appliances.

10. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.

11. When learning Doors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Doors.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Doors.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Doors.

12. When learning Roof Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Roof Construction.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Roof Construction.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Roof Construction.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Roof Construction.

13. When learning Domestic Water Supply, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Domestic Water Supply.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Domestic Water Supply.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Domestic Water Supply.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Domestic Water Supply.

14. When learning Construction Hand Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Hand Power Tools.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.

15. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

16. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Run with the tool

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Doors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Windows and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Domestic Water Supply and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Sanitary Appliances and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Drainage Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Building Construction Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Construction Hand Power Tools and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Construction Plant and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
